source_title: How Do I Refund A Transaction
snippet_primary:
> "In order to refund a customer, you'll want to log into your PayPal/Stripe account and find the user's details/transaction."

> "Please be aware that your refunds in PayPal/Stripe will also be reflected in Payhip. Since the refunded amount is taken into consideration in all places, the numbers shown on your monthly sales report and analytics will reflect that."
subject_exact: Reembolsos gestionados desde la cuenta PayPal/Stripe del seller, reflejándose en Payhip y en el sales report y analytics mensuales
local_qualifiers: the refunded amount is taken into consideration in all places
parser_notes: Mecánica declarada: el reembolso lo ejecuta el seller en el procesador (PayPal/Stripe), no en la plataforma; capas declaradas.
Marcadores de cita '>' del packet preservados.
